storage: Whole: cool, dry place for 1–2 weeks. Opened halves: wrap and refrigerate, use within 2–3 days. Grated: airtight box in the fridge for 3–4 days, or freeze in portions (e.g. 40 g bags for this curry) for up to about 3 months; thaw before grinding.
looksLike: A round, hard, brown, hairy shell about the size of a large fist (husk already removed), with water sloshing inside. Cracked open, it has a thick layer of firm, bright-white flesh, which is grated into moist white shreds.
shelfLife: Whole and unopened: 1–2 weeks at room temperature (longer in the fridge). Grated fresh: 3–4 days in the fridge. Frozen grated: several months.

usedIn.raw: 40 g grated (⅓ cup, loosely packed); fresh, or frozen and thawed
